name: Aamir Peerzada
bio: Aamir is working as a Head Of Sales & Business Development for Connect Resources. A Sales focused with a proven track record of influencing business growth, large-scale project implementation Inspiring team members to adept at motivating Sales & Business Development and Account Management Team to reach established goals. With over 9+ years of enriching experience Aamir has worked across a variety of domains, including Staffing, Outsourcing, Recruitment and many more.
